title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: Stocks rebounding Wed after Tue selloff (Dow -0.2%, S&P -0.7%, Nasdaq -1.3%, chips hit hardest) as Treasury said it will boost long-bond buybacks
Yields: 30-yr Treasury eased ~9bps to 5.19% after touching 5.34% Tue, its highest in nearly two decades, driven partly by AI industry's debt appetite
Oil: Brent above $91/bbl on 4th day of gains; a projectile hit a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz after the US-Iran truce expired with no deal in sight
Chips: Global selloff eased after SK Hynix announced a $29B share buyback
Klarna -23% (worst day since Feb) after cutting 2026 revenue guidance on soft German spending, despite a strong Q2
Moderna roughly doubled on positive Phase 3 cancer vaccine trial results; BioNTech +19%
Policy: Trump admin delayed 50% tariffs on Canadian goods by 3 days citing a tentative deal; FOMC July minutes due out
Ahead: Target and TJX report earnings
